notes.title: Down the Rabbit Hole's First Patch is Live!
notes.notes:
Down the Rabbit Hole 1.01

If you haven't taken the plunge down the rabbit hole, now's a great time to discover why so many people are raving about their VR adventure through Wonderland. This patch includes:

The addition of multiple save slots 
Lots of bug fixes
Puzzles that were written in English now have pictures
Subtitles for seven new languages:

Chinese
Japanese
Korean
Italian
Portuguese (Brazil)
Spanish (Latin America)
French (Canada)
